Additionally, the agro-forestry areas are adjacent to a small patch of arable land, covering less than 5% (72,000 sqm) of the total area and is distributed over two individual marginal areas. The pastures and transitional woodland or shrubs do not share a border with each other but both are adjacent to the agro-forestry areas, while the arable land shares a border with the agro-forestry areas. The landscape is characterized by a mix of agricultural areas and forest and seminatural areas, highlighting the varied ecosystems present in this region.
